title: Omni-Reward: Towards Generalist Omni-Modal Reward Modeling with Free-Form Preferences
paper_type_zh: 多模态偏好数据集、奖励模型与偏好评测
best_for_zh: 需要构建跨模态奖励模型，或审计自由文本偏好准则的研究者。
one_line: Omni-RewardData provides multimodal preference pairs and free-form criteria for generalist reward modeling.
Omni-RewardData 将跨五种模态的候选比较与自由文本偏好准则一起公开，使通用奖励模型能够按指定判断维度评分。
why: It makes modality and preference criterion part of the reward record instead of treating all pairwise labels as interchangeable.
inclusion_reason: Generalist multimodal preference data with an explicit official release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most open reward data is concentrated in text or image tasks and represents preference as a fixed binary label. That leaves a practical gap for a model that must judge video, audio, 3D, and text under an explicitly stated user criterion. Omni-Reward targets this feedback-data boundary rather than proposing a reward architecture alone.

The released object is a multimodal candidate comparison paired with a free-form preference condition. It belongs to Track 02 because the pair and its feedback are used to train reward models; Omni-RewardBench is a secondary evaluation surface, not the reason for inclusion.

公开奖励数据长期集中在文本或图像任务，并把偏好简化为固定二元标签。当模型需要在视频、音频、三维和文本中按用户明确说明的标准判断时，这种数据对象就不够用。Omni-Reward 解决的是这一反馈数据边界，而不只是提出新的奖励模型结构。

其公开记录是带有自由文本偏好条件的多模态候选比较。它属于 Track 02，因为候选对及其反馈用于训练奖励模型；Omni-RewardBench 是次要评测面，不是纳入本卡的中心理由。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Omni-Reward contributes Omni-RewardData, with 248K general preference pairs and 69K instruction-tuning examples, plus discriminative and generative reward models. A record identifies the modality, candidate content, and free-form preference criterion rather than treating “better” as a universal label. That contract lets a downstream system score or explain a preference in the requested dimension.
Omni-Reward 的核心贡献是 Omni-RewardData：24.8 万条通用偏好对和 6.9 万条指令样本，以及相应的判别式、生成式奖励模型。记录同时标明模态、候选内容和自由文本偏好准则，不再把“更好”当作脱离语境的通用标签。这一契约允许下游系统在指定维度上评分或解释偏好。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Collect or construct multimodal candidate examples across text, image, video, audio, and 3D. 2. Associate each comparison with a general preference relation and, where applicable, free-form preference instructions. 3. Release the records as Omni-RewardData. 4. Train discriminative and generative reward models on the records. 5. Evaluate with Omni-RewardBench and related reward-model tests. Reuse requires checking modality-specific files, criteria, licenses, and separation from benchmark tasks.
1. 收集或构建文本、图像、视频、音频和三维候选样本。2. 为候选比较附加通用偏好关系，并在适用时附加自由文本偏好指令。3. 将记录发布为 Omni-RewardData。4. 用这些记录训练判别式和生成式奖励模型。5. 以 Omni-RewardBench 和其他奖励模型测试评估。复用时必须核对各模态文件、准则、许可和与评测任务的隔离。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports 248K general preference pairs and 69K instruction-tuning examples across five modalities; this is the decisive evidence that the contribution is an open multimodal feedback dataset. It also reports results for discriminative and generative models on Omni-RewardBench and established reward-model benchmarks. Exact metric, baseline, and split comparisons must be taken from the paper tables and matched to the downloaded data revision.
论文报告 Omni-RewardData 含 24.8 万条通用偏好对和 6.9 万条指令样本，覆盖五种模态；这构成其为公开多模态反馈数据集的决定性证据。论文还报告判别式和生成式模型在 Omni-RewardBench 及既有奖励模型基准上的结果。精确指标、基线和切分差异须从论文表格核对，并与下载的数据版本对应。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Relative to reward datasets that bind a fixed pairwise label to one modality, Omni-Reward changes the feedback object by carrying a free-form preference condition across five modalities. The auditable change is not merely a larger model: the downstream judge can be conditioned on what the user asks it to value. Before reuse, inspect whether those criteria are genuinely comparable between modalities and whether a criterion is prompt-injected or annotation-derived.
相对于把固定两两标签绑定到单一模态的奖励数据，Omni-Reward 改变了反馈对象：它在五种模态上携带自由文本偏好条件。可审计的变化不是单纯增大模型，而是让下游评判器可以按用户要求的价值维度条件化。复用前应检查这些准则能否跨模态比较，以及准则来自提示注入还是标注过程。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Free-form criteria can be ambiguous, underspecified, or adversarially phrased, so agreement on one criterion need not transfer to another. Modality coverage can conceal uneven data quality across text, image, video, audio, and 3D; audit per-modality counts and errors. Finally, benchmark contamination is a direct risk when the same task family supports training and Omni-RewardBench evaluation; inspect prompt and asset overlap.
自由文本准则可能含糊、信息不足或可被对抗性表述利用，因此对某一准则的一致并不保证可迁移到另一准则。五种模态的覆盖也可能掩盖质量不均，应审计各模态的数量和错误。训练任务与 Omni-RewardBench 同属任务族会带来污染风险，必须检查提示词与资产重合。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Omni-RewardData when training a reward model that must condition on a stated preference rather than a fixed global ranking. Preserve modality and criterion fields, then evaluate each modality separately before pooling. Success means the model follows the requested criterion on held-out pairs without defaulting to superficial style cues. It is unsuitable when a task requires expert or safety-critical judgments that the released criterion does not specify.
当需要训练一个按明确偏好要求作判断的奖励模型，而非固定全局排序器时，可使用 Omni-RewardData。应保留模态和准则字段，并在汇总前按模态单独评估。成功标准是模型能在留出候选对上遵循指定准则，而非默认追逐表面风格。若任务需要该数据未定义的专家或高风险判断，则不适合直接使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The data object is a multimodal candidate comparison plus a free-form preference condition.
  2. Coverage spans text, image, video, audio, and 3D.
  3. Reported scale is 248K preference pairs and 69K instruction examples.
  4. Both discriminative and generative reward models consume the records.
  5. Audit modality imbalance, criterion ambiguity, and benchmark overlap before reuse.

1. 数据对象是多模态候选比较加自由文本偏好条件。
  2. 覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频和三维内容。
  3. 报告规模为 24.8 万条偏好对和 6.9 万条指令样本。
  4. 判别式和生成式奖励模型都可消费这些记录。
  5. 复用前审计模态不均衡、准则歧义和基准重合。
